tickId.description: Monotonic tick identifier within the session.

timestampUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the tick snapshot was captured.

framePath.description: Session-relative path associated with the tick's requested frame, for example frames/frame-tick-00000001.jpg. The referenced file may later be deleted by retention.

frameCaptureStatus.description: Frame capture/write status. QUEUED means capture/write was requested, not that the file is guaranteed to exist yet.

frameCaptureWarning.description: Optional warning about frame capture fidelity, such as screen-rectangle overlap risk.

captureErrors.description: Capture section names that failed while still allowing the tick record to be written.

writerQueueSize.description: Approximate telemetry record queue size observed when the tick was captured.

writerDroppedRecords.description: Total telemetry records dropped because the writer queue was full.
